note: Giardini Op. 26 numbering and keys are confirmed by Hungaroton's digital track titles; the Apple track list for that disc has wrong durations (Op. 26 No. 3, 4, 6), use Deezer. Gaps for the owner: Gibbs's 1958 String Quartet in E minor (recorded, Atchison/Convivium CR083) is not in the catalogue; Giordani 105634 (Op. 2 No. 6) also lacks the year 1772; Gerhard 'Trio No. 2' (1918) is listed by Wikipedia but not found recorded. Orlando Gibbons's six-part Fantasia No. 5 is typeset Tr Tr A T T B on IMSLP (Folop), not two basses; left as is. Giardini Op. 23 No. 1 (102454, outside this chunk) is for violin, 2 violas, cello per IMSLP and its entry already says so.
